name: SOC 2 (Trust Services Criteria)
description: Common Criteria controls for security, availability, and confidentiality.

rules.title: Logical access control & least privilege
rules.requirement: The document must describe logical access controls restricting access to systems and data based on least privilege and role-based access.

rules.title: Encryption in transit & at rest
rules.requirement: Sensitive data must be encrypted both in transit and at rest using industry-standard algorithms.

rules.title: Change management
rules.requirement: There must be a documented change management process governing how changes to systems are authorized, tested, and deployed.

rules.title: Logging & monitoring
rules.requirement: Systems must be monitored, and security events logged and reviewed to detect anomalies and unauthorized activity.

rules.title: Incident response
rules.requirement: There must be a documented incident response plan describing how security incidents are detected, escalated, and remediated.

rules.title: Vendor / third-party risk management
rules.requirement: The document must describe how third-party vendors are assessed and monitored for security risk.
